# PlasticFolder.in — custom CMYK-printed plastic folders &amp; sleeves

> Custom CMYK printing on recycled polypropylene (PP) — folders, sleeves and pockets produced in Chennai, India, delivered across Europe and worldwide. Paper-grade print quality (CMYK + white, 300 dpi) on a waterproof, unbreakable, 100% recyclable plastic.

## Key facts
- Product: custom CMYK printed plastic folders/sleeves (polypropylene, 0.2mm standard; 250µ bags)
- Standard formats: C00/C01/F01 309×220mm; D00/D01 330×220mm; C20/C21 310×240mm; B01 378×259mm; or fully custom die
- Prices (0.2mm PP, excl. GST): 500 pcs → ₹99/unit (₹49,500 total); 1000 pcs → ₹93/unit (₹93,000); 2000 pcs → ₹89/unit (₹178,000); &gt;2000 → quote
- Options: matte/glossy, selective UV, Pantone &amp; metallic inks (gold/silver), 3D lenticular, PP business-card pocket, custom polybag, labeling, anti-RFID
- Design services: Basic ₹5,000 / Advanced ₹10,000 / Additional quote
- Delivery: 2–4 weeks, UPS/TNT, Europe + islands; shipping included in quotes; 50 per polybag standard
- Materials: recycled PP (1 tonne recycled saves ~830 L oil), inks free of mineral/vegetable oils (AGEC law n° 2020-105, decree n° 2020-1725 MOAH/MOSH 1%→0.1% 2024/2025)
- Clients (selected): Fujifilm, SoftBank Robotics, TOEI Animation, Ordre des Notaires (France), Messer Medical, Doki-Doki, Eurodye CTC, ILL
- Contact: sale@plasticfolder.in · info@plasticfolder.in · +91 900 310 7128 · Chennai, India
- Response time: same day or next day
- Languages: French (primary market: Europe), English
